description: Send the user's quote request to a venue or vendor through Düğün.com. The business will contact the user by phone or e-mail, and Düğün.com e-mails the user a confirmation (and, for an address not yet verified, a link to verify it). BEFORE calling: (1) call get_quote_form and collect every required answer from the user, (2) show the user exactly what will be sent and to whom, (3) get their explicit yes and their acceptance of the Düğün.com terms of use (https://dugun.com/kurumsal/gizlilik/terms), privacy notice (https://dugun.com/kurumsal/gizlilik/kvkk) and privacy policy (https://dugun.com/kurumsal/gizlilik): show them these links. Only then set confirmed and accepted_terms to true. Send one request per business; never resend on your own.

accepted_terms.description: true only after the user accepted the Düğün.com terms of use (https://dugun.com/kurumsal/gizlilik/terms), privacy notice (https://dugun.com/kurumsal/gizlilik/kvkk) and privacy policy (https://dugun.com/kurumsal/gizlilik).

answers.description: The other form answers, keyed by the form's field name, e.g. {"data.4": 5, "data.5": "Açık havada nikah istiyoruz"}. For a field with options send the option value.

confirmed.description: true only after the user approved this exact request.

phone.description: With country code, e.g. +90 5XX XXX XX XX.

provider_id.description: venue_id or provider_id from the search tools.

wedding_date.description: One of the weddingDate option values of the form (YYYY-MM-DD).
